intent: A bright candle-gold sun-court gown with a wine underlayer showing between ivory pleats, a wide ivory sun-disc collar and a rayed gold crown, flaring into a broad bell that reads gold, wine and ivory from the high camera.
reason: Sun-disc queen: the run's best invention, a sun-disc crown and ruff collar over a pleated gold skirt that flares at the front, the only one that reads as gold from far off (5.70, third; first critic 6.53, first).
first_fix: All one saturated gold reads as a gold box from above: make the bodice and sleeves wine or dark gold, keep bright gold for trim, and carry the flare and stripes round the back.
